name: China Creek
blurb: They banned the board, then sold the bowl. A defended-public-space manifesto in concrete grey and caution yellow.

stages.title: The Mood
stages.blurb: Moodboards — the texture, palette and references the kit grows from.

images.caption: Cut-and-paste skate-zine moodboard collage of jersey, crests, tags and protest headlines
images.prompt: A layered skate-zine cut-and-paste collage, photocopied flyers and ransom-note headlines, heavy xerox grain, toner-black ink on bone newsprint with caution-yellow accents, DIY punk screenprint grit, slight misregistration. No faces.

images.caption: Flat-lay still life of skateboard, bowl-contour line graphic, spray can and parks-permit tag
images.prompt: A graphic still life: a skatepark bowl cross-section with a coping line beside a skateboard deck silhouette and a spray can. Objects only, no person, no face. Marker-black and caution-yellow on concrete grey, clean prop lighting, emblematic icon study.

stages.title: The Marks
stages.blurb: Crests, patterns, nameplates, numbers and typography — the language of the kit.

images.caption: Yellow "China Creek Local" stencil sprayed on cracked concrete bowl coping
images.prompt: Extreme close-up of a weathered concrete skatepark bowl, the coping lip and a smooth transition curve, wax marks, scuffs and hairline cracks, faint caution-yellow paint flecks, raw East Vancouver DIY concrete, hard daylight. Full-bleed.

images.caption: Yellow and teal arrow stencil spray-painted on raw concrete pillar with China Creek protest tag
images.prompt: Spray-stencil graffiti on a raw concrete wall, hard-edged stencil arrows and bars, caution yellow and creek teal over grey, overspray haze and drips, East Van underpass texture, weathered and tactile.

images.caption: Seamless all-over bowl-contour topographic pattern tile in grey, teal and yellow
images.prompt: A seamless tile of the hero pattern: an elegant tonal field of nested skatepark bowl contours and coping curves, thin caution-yellow and creek-teal line-art on concrete grey, refined topographic rhythm, tight enough to repeat as an all-over sublimated fabric print. white background.

images.caption: Bowl-and-coping shield crest in grey with teal and yellow outline
images.prompt: A clean heraldic sports crest: a host-city shield with a single skatepark bowl cross-section and coping line inside, refined gold-and-teal line-art on concrete grey, premium emblem, no clutter. white background.

images.caption: Woven grey hem tag embroidered with yellow PUBLIC LAND / PRIVATE PROFIT slogan
images.prompt: A small refined tag lockup reading "PUBLIC LAND / PRIVATE PROFIT" in fine caution-yellow type on concrete grey, discreet woven-label aesthetic. white background.

images.caption: Woven 'no skateboarding' bylaw patch in yellow and black
images.prompt: A small premium woven sleeve patch of a "NO SKATEBOARDING" pictogram, tasteful and restrained, caution yellow and marker black with a stitched border, the size of a real kit sleeve patch (not a big sticker). white background.

images.caption: Layered number 79 in green, yellow and grey with protest-kit tag
images.prompt: A large jersey number that reads exactly "79" (digit seven then digit nine), built from elegant nested coping curves, caution-yellow and creek-teal line-art on concrete grey, premium and clean. white background.

images.caption: DEFEND PUBLIC SPACE circular badge with skate-bowl icon
images.prompt: A small official circular fair-play-style badge reading "DEFEND PUBLIC SPACE", creek-teal border, concrete-grey field, a tiny bowl-coping icon at centre, tournament conduct-badge aesthetic, refined. white background.

stages.title: The Flats
stages.blurb: Technical jersey flats — front, back, the complete kit laid out.

images.caption: Yellow front jersey flat with NO SKATEBOARDING bylaw sign graphic and colorway legend
images.prompt: Macro of a municipal "NO SKATEBOARDING" prohibition sign, the pictogram bold and official, scratched and sticker-covered metal, caution yellow and marker black, bureaucratic city-signage texture. The sign reads as a brand mark.

images.caption: Concrete colorway jersey front and back mockup on wall, number 77, topographic pattern
images.prompt: A clean line-art transition map of nested skatepark bowl contours and coping curves, thin caution-yellow and creek-teal lines on concrete grey, technical topographic feel, tight enough to read as an all-over fabric pattern.

images.caption: Concrete-grey colorway jersey flat, front and back, number 77 with bowl crest
images.prompt: Technical flat-lay fashion illustration of a premium unisex soccer jersey, concrete-grey body carrying an elegant tonal all-over pattern of nested skatepark bowl contours and coping curves in thin caution-yellow and creek-teal line-art, a bold clean "VANCOUVER" wordmark across the chest, a small refined bowl-and-coping crest on the left chest, one discreet woven bylaw patch on the sleeve, generous clean negative space, high-end editorial sportswear, uncluttered, ready for production. white background.

images.caption: Caution-yellow colorway jersey flat with grey raglan sleeves and bowl crest
images.prompt: Technical flat-lay fashion illustration of a premium unisex soccer jersey, rich caution-yellow body with a tonal tone-on-tone all-over pattern of nested skatepark bowl contours and coping curves, concrete-grey raglan sleeves, a creek-teal coping line at the collar, a bold clean "VANCOUVER" wordmark across the chest, a small refined bowl-and-coping crest, no large sticker, high-end editorial sportswear, confident and minimal. white background.

images.caption: Concrete-grey jersey back flat, CHINA CREEK nameplate over number 79 in teal and yellow
images.prompt: Technical flat-lay fashion illustration of the jersey back, matching body and tonal bowl-contour pattern, a clean arched "CHINA CREEK" nameplate, a large number "79" built from elegant nested coping curves, a single thin creek-teal line at the collar, a small hem line of fine print, premium and uncluttered, editorial sportswear. white background.

images.caption: Side and sleeve detail of grey jersey with teal piping and yellow NO SKATEBOARDING patch
images.prompt: Technical fashion flat of the jersey from the side, tonal bowl-contour pattern, a small tasteful woven "NO SKATEBOARDING" bylaw patch on the sleeve (subtle, not a chest sticker), a creek-teal coping line down the raglan seam, a refined inside-collar tag, premium athletic construction detail, clean. white background.

images.caption: Complete concrete-grey kit: jersey, shorts and socks with topographic pattern
images.prompt: Technical flat-lay of a complete premium soccer kit: jersey in concrete grey with the tonal bowl-contour pattern, matching shorts with a single coping-curve sweep, socks with a thin caution-yellow and creek-teal coping band, cohesive high-end colourway, clean negative space, editorial lookbook layout, uncluttered. white background.

images.caption: Concrete-grey jersey front flat with bold bowl-contour all-over pattern and crew neck trim
images.prompt: Technical flat-lay fashion illustration of a premium unisex soccer jersey, concrete-grey body carrying an elegant tonal all-over pattern of nested skatepark bowl contours and coping curves in thin caution-yellow and creek-teal line-art, a bold clean "VANCOUVER" wordmark across the chest, a small refined bowl-and-coping crest on the left chest, one discreet woven bylaw patch on the sleeve, generous clean negative space, high-end editorial sportswear, uncluttered, ready for production. white background.

stages.title: On the Body
stages.blurb: Editorial lifestyle — the kit in the world, on people.

images.caption: Worn skateboard decks with China Creek local-identity sticker graphics
images.prompt: Flat-lay close-up of a skateboard deck underside and black griptape, peeling stickers, marker scrawl, worn edges and chipped ply, DIY screen-print texture, tactile skate-culture object study.

images.caption: Open skate-tourism brochure spread with grey V-neck kit folded beside caution tape and no-skateboarding sign
images.prompt: Flat lay of a glossy city skate-tourism brochure, aspirational destination-marketing layout, clean sans-serif headlines and gold accents on cream, sanctioned and too-polished, the official gloss the kit will turn against itself. No faces.

images.caption: Model wearing grey kit, front torso crop at skate bowl, bowl crest and VANCOUVER wordmark
images.prompt: Editorial sports-fashion lookbook shot, a person wearing the concrete-grey China Creek jersey, framed from shoulders to waist, head cropped out of frame above the chest, the tonal bowl-contour pattern and clean "VANCOUVER" wordmark catching soft studio light, premium athletic styling, shallow depth of field, confident posture. No face in frame.

images.caption: Player walking away at golden-hour skate bowl, grey jersey back with CHINA CREEK 79
images.prompt: Editorial lookbook shot from behind, a person walking away wearing the China Creek jersey, the "CHINA CREEK" nameplate and number "79" in coping-curve line-art centred, an empty concrete skatepark bowl softly out of focus beyond, golden-hour East Vancouver light, premium and cinematic. No face visible.

images.caption: Three-quarter hero of player in yellow kit holding skateboard at the bowl under grey sky
images.prompt: Editorial sports-fashion shot, a person in the caution-yellow China Creek jersey standing three-quarter, cropped just below the eyes so no face shows, a skateboard held at the side, raw concrete bowl and chain-link behind, overcast PNW light, premium streetwear-meets-football styling, the tonal pattern reading clearly. No identifiable face.

images.caption: Close-up shoulder detail of grey jersey with yellow NO SKATEBOARDING woven patch and teal piping
images.prompt: Close lookbook detail of the jersey worn, the shoulder and sleeve filling the frame, the discreet woven "NO SKATEBOARDING" bylaw patch and the creek-teal coping line at the raglan seam in crisp focus, premium fabric texture, soft directional light, no face in frame.

images.caption: Model in beanie wearing grey jersey under graffiti underpass, bowl crest and VANCOUVER wordmark
images.prompt: Editorial sports-fashion lookbook portrait, a confident young skater wearing the concrete-grey China Creek jersey, the tonal bowl-contour pattern and clean "VANCOUVER" wordmark catching soft studio light, premium athletic styling, shallow depth of field, strong direct attitude, magazine-quality.

images.caption: Player from behind facing concrete bowl at golden hour, light kit back with CHINA CREEK 79
images.prompt: Editorial lookbook shot from behind, a person walking toward an empty concrete skatepark bowl wearing the China Creek jersey, the "CHINA CREEK" nameplate and a number that reads exactly "79" in coping-curve line-art centred on the back, golden-hour East Vancouver light, cinematic and premium.
